purpose: A calendar page with odd facts, which often sparks a sketch. Starting somewhere new, away from the esoteric pages I read today.

pages.title: November 20
pages.reaction: A calendar page, so mostly dates and lists. The Essex and the sperm whale is a good story, and Lake Peigneur draining into a salt mine is the kind of accident I wish I could build on purpose. Not much to make from it, but the odd facts are fun.
